caption: The drawing depicts a two-panel wooden folding screen or door, shown at an angle where both panels are visible and slightly opened inward. Each panel contains ornate, three-dimensional relief decorations. The upper sections of both panels feature a large, intricate, symmetrical, scrolling floral or foliage motif enclosed within a raised, rectangular border with rope-like detailing. The lower sections of both panels also possess a rectangular decorative element with smaller, swirling relief patterns, framed by similar rope-like borders. The overall color palette of the drawing consists of various shades of beige, brown, and muted gold, with hints of blue and green on the raised portions of the decorative patterns. The hinges connecting the two panels are golden in color, and both panels rest on small, round caster wheels. The background of the drawing is plain, uncolored, and a scale notation "SCALE 1/2 inch TO 1 foot" is written below the panels in the center.
title: Doors
